page: Google Cloud Platform a3-edgegpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server configured with eight NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, providing a total of 640 GB of VRAM. The system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with an x86_64 architecture, offering 208 vCPUs across 104 physical cores with a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It features 1872.0 GB of dedicated system memory, translating to 9.0 GB per core, alongside a 105 MB L3 cache. Local storage is provided via 6432 GB of NVMe SSD capacity.

In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU tests. Its memory subsystem achieves top-tier read and write bandwidth, with cached small-block reads reaching 13661.0 GB/sec. The hardware acceleration capabilities are highlighted by top-tier performance in Geekbench ray tracing and PassMark extended instructions, which leverage built-in AVX-512 and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). Database operations and Redis SET throughput also rank in the top 10%, processing 177.5 million operations per second.

Given its dense hardware profile featuring eight high-end GPUs, massive system memory, and local NVMe storage, this server represents a high-resource tier optimized for extreme compute density. The consolidation of massive parallel processing power and high-speed local storage makes it highly cost-efficient for workloads that require maximum throughput per node, minimizing network overhead. It is designed for demanding workloads such as large language model training and inference, high-performance database operations, ray tracing, and intensive scientific computing.
